description: This file is a shell script containing a series of test cases to check the behavior of git diff commands with various options and conditions. It sets up repositories, makes commits, compares changes, and validates command outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Function used to define a test case expecting success, runs a block of shell commands and checks their success.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks if the previous command's exit status matches the expected code.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Validates the line count of output stored in a variable or file.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
